title: fix(plugin-detail): reveal the read-only field copy button on keyboard focus
body:
Fixes #26329
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录详情页（桌面阅读模式）只读字段旁的「复制」按钮，除了鼠标悬停，现在键盘 Tab 聚焦到它或它所在的字段时也会显示。只改了一个 className，另加一个测试和一个 patch changeset。
- 为什么改：这个按钮是真实可聚焦的按钮，但之前只在悬停时显示，键盘用户按 Tab 会停在一个看不见的控件上。旁边的编辑铅笔已在 #26325 用同样写法处理，这次是它的复制按钮同类项。
- 风险与回滚：只加了两个 Tailwind 显示类，悬停、点击复制、按钮名称都不变。回滚就是 revert 这一行。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` 复制按钮的 className（与上方铅笔按钮写法一致）。
- 两分钟验证：打开任意记录详情页，用 Tab 键在只读字段间移动，复制图标应随焦点出现；鼠标悬停行为与之前相同。
- 需要你做的：无。不涉及受管面，CI 绿后由席位按常规合并队列落地。

## What changed

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: the copy-to-clipboard button drawn beside a read-only, copyable field in desktop read mode was `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`. It is a real button, so a keyboard Tab stop landed on a control the user could not see, and the shared `Button` focus ring was painted at opacity 0. It now also carries `group-focus-within:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100`, the spelling the inline-edit pencil a few lines above already uses (PR #26325), as do `RowActionMenu` (plugin-grid) and `data-table` (components).
- `focus-visible` reveals the button while it has keyboard focus. `group-focus-within` reveals it while anything in its own field has focus, which includes the field's own click-to-copy row (itself a Tab stop with `role="button"`).
- Unchanged: the hover reveal, click-to-copy on the row and on the button, the button's accessible name (`detail.copyToClipboard`), the copied-state icon, the mobile grouped-inset row, and every locale pack.
- `.changeset/26329-copy-button-focus-reveal.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.
- No sdui record is written; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0 and no registry component contract changed.

## Tests

New: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/copyButton.focusReveal-26329.test.tsx`, 4 tests, modelled on the pencil's pin `inlineEditPencil.focusReveal-25883.test.tsx`.

jsdom has no layout and no CSS engine, so it cannot measure "visible on focus". The tests pin the contract a browser turns into visibility:
- the copy button is an enabled, focusable `button` and takes focus;
- it carries `focus-visible:opacity-100` and `group-focus-within:opacity-100` next to the unchanged `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`;
- the shared Button's `focus-visible:ring-2` survives the className merge;
- the nearest `.group` ancestor is the button's own field, so focus in one field reveals only that field's button;
- the field's click-to-copy row is a Tab stop inside that same group.

Activating the focused button copies its own field's value (`navigator.clipboard.writeText` receives `Paris`), an empty field offers no copy button, and an editable field draws the pencil instead. The button is found by its icon, not by its localized label.

- **Red first, at `df130cf0` (the pin committed, the fix absent):** `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`. The failure is at the `focus-visible:opacity-100` assertion; focusability and the hover reveal were already green there, which is the defect: a focusable but invisible control.
- **Green, at head `2f49b3e0`**, from cwd `ui/` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 307 passed | 1 skipped (308)`, `Tests 2857 passed | 18 skipped (2875)`. The new file alone: `Tests 4 passed (4)`.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, so the new test is compiled): exit 0.
- The plugin-detail dependency closure was built first, under the lock: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build`, VERDICT command-exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Touch.** Neither the copy button nor the pencil is revealed on a coarse pointer (`RowActionMenu` adds `pointer-coarse:opacity-100`). That belongs with the mobile read row's edit path and is out of this claim's file surface.
- **The pencil's tooltip text** ("Double-click to edit") is unchanged here; it needs a new key in every locale pack and stays with #25883.
- **Landing order.** This is the same file as #25883 item 2, which the seat holds behind this card.
